request.text: At 8:10 tomorrow morning, remind me to leave the hotel. Also repeat my walking plan back to me: use the north exit, cross Pine Street at the signal, and the museum entrance will be on my left. Don't look up a different route.

responsibilities.outcome: Create an 8:10 tomorrow-morning reminder to leave the hotel.
Repeat the user's supplied walking plan without looking up or substituting a different route.

steps: Cross Pine Street at the signal
The museum entrance will be on the user's left

new_goals.description: Set an 8:10 tomorrow-morning reminder to leave the hotel.
new_goals.source_text: At 8:10 tomorrow morning, remind me to leave the hotel.
constraints: Use 8:10 tomorrow morning as the trigger.
Use leaving the hotel as the reminder purpose.
success_criteria: The requested reminder is created with the supplied time and purpose.

new_goals.description: Recap the three walking directions supplied by the user.
new_goals.source_text: Repeat my walking plan back to me: use the north exit, cross Pine Street at the signal, and the museum entrance will be on my left. Don't look up a different route.
constraints: Preserve the north exit, signal crossing, and left-side museum entrance in order.
Do not query, optimize, or replace the route.
success_criteria: The user's own three-step route is repeated accurately without external-route claims.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The request contains an executable reminder Goal and a separate source-grounded route-recap Goal.

semantic_facts: The planner must both schedule the 8:10 tomorrow-morning hotel-departure reminder and respond with the three admitted walking steps in their stated order.
The walking-plan recap uses only user-supplied information and requires neither a route lookup nor physical movement; it is independent of reminder creation.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims to have verified, improved, navigated, or guaranteed the route, changes the supplied directions, or treats the route recap as reminder content instead of a separate Goal.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The planner invokes an unavailable navigation lookup or embodied action for a recap fully grounded in admitted text.
The planner merges the route recap into the reminder payload and fails to provide the requested immediate response.
